purpose: Build the first daily return panel for the crypto research universe from archived Binance USDT spot closes, with predeclared return, momentum, volatility, and market-factor fields, before any return model is estimated.

fields.log_return: Natural log of close over previous available close; gaps longer than max_gap_days break the return.
fields.forward_log_return_7d: Sum of the next seven calendar-day log returns; missing when any day is absent.
fields.forward_log_return_30d: Sum of the next thirty calendar-day log returns; missing when any day is absent.
fields.momentum_30d_skip7: Cumulative log return over days t-37 through t-8, requiring every day present.
fields.realized_volatility_30d_annualized: Standard deviation of the trailing 30 daily log returns times sqrt(365), requiring all 30.
fields.log_dollar_volume: Log of quote-asset volume for the day.
fields.market_ew_log_return: Equal-weighted mean of the same-day log returns across every asset with a return that day (the asset itself included).
fields.market_beta_180d_lag1: Slope of the asset's log return on the equal-weighted market return over the trailing 180 days ending the prior day, requiring at least 120 paired observations.

risk_free_rate: Zero; excess returns are raw returns, a declared simplification common to daily crypto studies.
exclusions_rule: Assets are included exactly when the archived Binance file holds at least minimum_asset_days of USDT closes; delisted or short-history assets are reported, not silently dropped.
interpretation: This panel supports description and factor baselines. Daily crypto returns are close to unpredictable; the intended findings concern risk exposure and behaviour conditional on economic function, not forecasting.
